brier_score_bar.title: Brier Score — lower is better
brier_score_bar.body: Measures how far off each probability forecast was from the actual outcome. 0 = perfect. 0.25 = random guess. Above 0.25 = worse than flipping a coin.

calibration_curve.title: Calibration Curve
calibration_curve.body: The diagonal line is perfect calibration. Points above = rep over-states confidence. Points below = rep sandbagging. Calibrate pushes dots toward the diagonal.

rep_bias_heatmap.title: Hidden Bias by Deal Type
rep_bias_heatmap.body: Red = rep over-states probability for this deal type. Blue = rep under-states. White = well calibrated. Darker = stronger signal.

quarter_timeline.title: Brier Score Over Time
quarter_timeline.body: Each point is one quarter's Brier score. The drop when Memory turns ON proves that Hindsight is doing real work — not just repackaging the rep's gut feeling.

revenue_error_bar.title: Revenue Forecast Error
revenue_error_bar.body: Positive = rep over-forecast (optimism bias). Negative = rep sandbagged. The agent-corrected bar should be shorter and closer to zero.

sub_chart_oneliners.trust_the_rep: Raw rep probability — no correction applied.
sub_chart_oneliners.agent_off: AI running without memory — same as trusting the rep.
sub_chart_oneliners.agent_on: AI with Hindsight memory — bias corrected.
sub_chart_oneliners.historical_baseline: Flat 63% win rate — the naive historical average.
sub_chart_oneliners.false_alarm_rate: Rules the AI invented that aren't in the rep's actual bias profile.
sub_chart_oneliners.bias_detection_rate: Share of planted biases the AI correctly identified.
sub_chart_oneliners.sana_improvement: Sana's over-confidence bias was no longer detected this quarter — a genuine improvement signal.
sub_chart_oneliners.pending_deals: Open deals excluded from scoring — outcomes not yet known.
